name: singlet_spatial_genes_neighborhood_enrichment
title: Cell-type neighbourhood enrichment
description: Tests whether cells of two labelled types are adjacent in a spatial neighbour graph more or less often than a label-shuffled null predicts, and returns a type-by-type z-score, count or fold-change matrix. Use it when labels are not derived from the same graph, since clustering on that graph makes enrichment circular. It writes uns/<cluster_key>_nhood_enrichment and does not model abundance or distance; use spatial-genes.cooccurrence_by_distance for distance curves.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

cluster_key.description: obs column with categorical cell-type or domain labels; must have no missing values.

method.description: Statistic and null. label_permutation_zscore is the published default; the others are comparators or descriptive.

graph.description: stored reads obsp/spatial_connectivities; knn6 and delaunay are built from obsm/spatial.

library_key.description: obs column; permutations stay within each library. Not allowed with endpoint_repairing_log2fc.

n_perms.description: Label permutations, or simulations for endpoint_repairing_log2fc.

seed.description: Random seed for permutations or simulations; a fixed seed and backend reproduce results.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

min_cell_count.description: Clusters with fewer cells are dropped and reported as NaN. Default 0 keeps all clusters.

handle_nan.description: keep leaves undefined z as NaN; zero sets it to 0 and can hide undefined enrichment.

adjust_method.description: Multiplicity adjustment of endpoint p-values used by PI. Giotto's own default is none.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. uns/cell_type_nhood_enrichment/zscore. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Compact summary for completed runs: method, graph, n_labels, n_directed_edges, n_perms_used, seed, top_enriched and top_depleted pairs, and dropped_labels. Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
